Name: Adoni-zedek, King of Jerusalem
Summary: Adoni-zedek was king of Jerusalem when he heard that Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and he led five kings against Gibeon.
KeyStory: Adoni-zedek's alliance was shattered by hailstones and a lengthened day at Beth-horon, and he was hanged with the four other kings at Makkedah.
RelatedPeople: Hoham, King of Hebron; Piram, King of Jarmuth; Japhia, King of Lachish; Debir, King of Eglon; Joshua
LifeLesson: Five kings against one God is still no contest.
